title: Counit of the ordered two-factor vector integration construction
statement: For an independently integration-normalized vector purity family, the full prescribed direct-sum compatibility law holds, with the canonical source comparison and actual exceptional mate. This is one compatibility clause, not the vector-bundle purity theorem.

source.place: paragraph 2; assembly step 4, normalized transpose in the published vector-purity coordinates

proof.text:
Use the finite locally free rank of the biproduct to form the sum bundle. Independently
normalize the family for the second factor and for the sum. The ordered geometric trace identity,
compact-support composition and base change identify the counit of the two-factor construction
with integration for the sum. Adjunction injectivity identifies this construction with the
independently normalized sum family. Even shifts give sign one. Independence of compactification
supplies the displayed actual compactification triangle. Rank zero uses the unit maps; empty
schemes have unique maps.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 2; the independent direct-sum portion of vector-bundle purity
